Built from the heart.

The Universe definitely wanted me to end up in this place, far from everything in the middle of nowhere.
This magical place, has been built by two super-humans Yuth and Doctor Pilant, only guided by their feelings and intuitions.
One, late adopted wonder-doctor with with an impressive academic training and the other a Phyto-pharmacist, acupuncturist and moxa therapist.
Together, they have created this place, in terracotta, free from superficiality and only based on what’s needed to heal.
I had multiple sessions with those two, working on my body and emotions together intensively. I am so grateful for that.

They don’t promote their place because only people who are meant to land there will find the place. So I share this from the heart, addressed to every soul in search of pure and trusted guidance.

I have been treated at this  clinic several times for various ailments - migraine, knee pain and IBS. I have had acupuncture, cupping, personalised flower remedies and chi Nei Tsang ( gut health treatment). I have always come away feeling a lot better - on both a physical and emotional level and it’s long lasting. Drs Yuth and Pilant are gentle, kind and effective giving more than you can imagine.  The clinic is environmentally built giving a truly healthy and  nurturing feeling. It’s always a pleasure to go there.  The clinic is a little out of the way but it’s worth the extra few kilometres. Thank you BVRC
Magical place. The doctors are professional and kind, very caring. They helped me heal my digestive issues. Highly recommend 💛 …
